title: Thickness of bounded constant-model constructibility
statement: Fix a prime ell and an admissible commutative condensed ring Λ, including coefficient presentations isomorphic to the finite, integral, finite-extension field or finite-subextension algebraic-closure representatives [sk-def-localizing-closure, sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring, sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed]. For a standing separated finite-type k-scheme X in positive characteristic different from ell [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting], the property Dbc(X,Λ) of bounded complexes with constant-model constructible cohomology [det-def-sfb-constructible-tor-amplitude] is triangulated and stable under retracts in the ambient ordinary unbounded derived category. There is no finite-Tor hypothesis on its objects. The coefficient rings and the scalar change functor are those of [def-sfb-scalar-six-coefficient-interfaces].

proof.text:
use the coefficient isomorphism from admissibility to reduce to a
native coefficient. In the finite case the normalized finite discrete equivalence
identifies bounded constant-model constructibility with the ordinary finite-ring
notion; proEtale_bounded_constructible_isTriangulated supplies triangles and shifts.
A retract has cohomology the kernel of its complementary idempotent; descend this
idempotent to the etale constructible heart and use its kernel closure, as in
finiteCtfRetractEtaleImages (the argument for constructibility uses only boundedness).
For integral coefficients integralConstantModelHeart gives triangulation and ambient
kernel closure; a cohomological retract is the kernel of one minus its idempotent,
so it remains constructible. For fields coefficientHeartTriangulated gives all three
properties directly. Vanishing outside a bounded interval is inherited by retracts
in all cases. The coefficient-isomorphism equivalence preserves cohomology, shifts,
triangles and the same finite constant models, hence transports these conclusions.
Zero coefficients and the empty scheme give the zero category and satisfy them too. The nodes used by this native-presentation argument are [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-over-noetherian], [lem-sfb-finite-ctf-retract-etale-images], [lem-weil-proetale-dbc-triangulated], [det-lem-int-integral-heart-triangulated], [sk-lem-coefficient-heart], [det-cor-coefficient-heart-ii-triangulated].

lean.statement:
theorem sfbAdmissibleConstructibleThickness (ell : ℕ) [Fact ell.Prime]
    (Λ : ScalarSixRing.{u}) (hΛ : IsLocalizingAdmissibleCoefficient ell Λ.X)
    (k : Type u) [Field k] [Fact (ringChar k).Prime] [Fact (ringChar k ≠ ell)]
    (X : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType X.hom] [QuasiCompact X.hom] [IsSeparated X.hom] :
    (constantModelBoundedConstructible Λ.X X.left).IsTriangulated ∧
      (constantModelBoundedConstructible Λ.X X.left).IsStableUnderRetracts
